sentences.text: This medium-sized hadrosauroid reached lengths between five and six meters.
Its frontal bones were elongated, measuring roughly seventy percent longer than they were wide.
Bony flaps formed by the rear parietal bones overlapped the supraoccipital and were themselves overlapped by the squamosals.
The genus name honors Batyr, the legendary Kazakh hero warriors.
The specific epithet rozhdestvenskyi commemorates the paleontologist Anatoly Konstantinovich Rozhdestvensky.
A four-centimeter-long thumb claw was preserved within the fossil material.
Pascal Godefroit, François Escuillié, Yuri Bolotsky, and Pascaline Lauters named and described the species in 2012.
It is classified within the class Ornithischia.
The taxon belongs to the parent group Hadrosauroidea.
Cladistic analysis places Batyrosaurus in a basal position within Hadrosauroidea, above Altirhinus but below Probactrosaurus.
Batyrosaurus lived during the Santonian to Campanian stages, from 85.7 to 72.2 million years ago.
It is known from the Late Cretaceous Bostobe Formation in central Kazakhstan, where researchers suggest it may be the same taxon as the doubtful Arstanosaurus akkurganensis.
